t: 七岁的利奥二世继承了外祖父利奥一世为拜占庭皇帝. 十个月后他就死了.
te: Seven-year-old Leo II succeeds his maternal grandfather Leo I as Byzantine emperor. He dies ten months later.
dz: 七岁的利奥二世继承了外祖父利奥一世为拜占庭皇帝. 十个月后他就死了.
de: Seven-year-old Leo II succeeds his maternal grandfather Leo I as Byzantine emperor. He dies ten months later.

t: 泽诺被加冕为东罗马帝国的同仁.
te: Zeno is crowned as co-emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire.
dz: 泽诺被加冕为东罗马帝国的同仁.
de: Zeno is crowned as co-emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire.

t: 朱利叶斯·内波斯(Julius Nepos)迫使罗马篡位者格里塞留斯放弃了王位并自称为西罗马帝…
te: Julius Nepos forces Roman usurper Glycerius to abdicate the throne and proclaims himself Emperor of the Western Roman E…
dz: 朱利叶斯·内波斯(Julius Nepos)迫使罗马篡位者格里塞留斯放弃了王位并自称为西罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Julius Nepos forces Roman usurper Glycerius to abdicate the throne and proclaims himself Emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

t: 皇帝利奥二世在统治了十个月后去世. 他由他的父亲泽诺接任,泽诺成为拜占庭帝国的唯一统治者.
te: Emperor Leo II dies after a reign of ten months. He is succeeded by his father Zeno, who becomes sole ruler of the Byza…
dz: 皇帝利奥二世在统治了十个月后去世. 他由他的父亲泽诺接任,泽诺成为拜占庭帝国的唯一统治者.
de: Emperor Leo II dies after a reign of ten months. He is succeeded by his father Zeno, who becomes sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire.
